note: scripts/clkcheck.py configuration. clocks = the values CLK_HZ / CLK_MD_HZ take (NTSC, PAL); source = the one place they are written; scope = the files checked (the Paprium RTL, the cartridge, the SDRAM controller, the Pocket top and the one upstream file the Pocket build uses with a clock literal); allow = literals that are NOT clock-derived, each with its exact count in that file (value '*' = a data table: R3 skips the file, R2 still applies) and why; pending = clock-derived literals below R3's threshold that another change of 0.3.0's stage 1 (the first stage of the new firmware and its RTL) converts (warnings until it does). Stage 5 in the why texts is the fifth stage of the 0.3.0 work, the music: our own song engine and synth (the Grand Stick III came in the same stage).

allow.why: echo length in 48 kHz samples (counted on the sample tick, not the clock)
WRAM depth in 32-bit words, four byte lanes (48 KB; this shape since test build 4, a build B Jam tested on his own Pocket; was 24,576 16-bit words)
the SFX output rate in Hz (dac_clocker divides CLK_HZ by it)
the album header's sample-rate field must read 48000
N_PU: CRAM power-up wait >= 150 us (8,054 clocks at NTSC). A minimum with 2x margin: a slower clock only adds time (PAL 308 us)
N_CEL: CE0# low >= 10 us to leave deep power-down (537 clocks at NTSC). A minimum with 2x margin (PAL 19.2 us)

stage 5 (the Grand Stick III): TMO, the stick's idle timeout in clk_sys clocks, set equal to the six-button pad's own (upstream pad_io's JTMR > 11600*7 = 81,200 clocks, 1.512 ms at NTSC, a fixed count in every build and outside this check's scope), which the stick's reader follows. Not game-visible inside 2,020-856,659 clocks (the game's read gaps were measured outside that window); the real stick's value is not known (a capture decides; the Paprium variant is NTSC-only)
stage 5 (the synth scheduler): tenths of a 48 kHz sample per second; the accumulator adds it each clock and wraps at CLK_HZ
stage 5 (the synth scheduler): the chip's TIM6 period is 1,001 tenths of a TIM8 period, counted on the tenth tick
stage 5 (the synth scheduler): the last entry of the chip's 1,920-entry DAC DMA rings
stage 5 (the synth scheduler): the chip's DAC DMA ring length in samples
the IMA ADPCM step table and 16-bit saturation
INC: the 12.5 MHz side of the INC / DIV fraction (DIV = CLK_MD_HZ / 50)

upstream, unmodified: fltce's IN_CLK. Its CE drives only psg_iir, whose output is used only when lpf_mode != 3; core_top ties lpf_mode to CFG_LPF = 3 (No Filter) in every variant, so the filter and its CE are pruned (seen by reading the code). If CFG_LPF ever changes, pass CLK_HZ here
fltce's OUT_CLK, the PSG filter's sample rate (pruned, as above)
audio filter rate and coefficients in the audio PLL's domain (not clk_sys)
audio PLL clock rate (12.288 MHz) and filter parameters
RESET_PULSE counts clk_74a (the APF bridge clock, 74.25 MHz in every variant)

done.by: the SDRAM refresh change of 0.3.0's first stage
done.now: RFS_TOP = CLK_MD_HZ / 128000 - 2 (NTSC 836, PAL 829); CLK_MD_HZ defaults to 0 (R4), core_top passes it through cartridge, and an unset value stops elaboration (sdram clk_md_hz_check)
